utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club’s coming up soon, right? I heard they’re picking something a little surprising this month.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that so? You’re sure it’s something surprising, not just a rumor?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Could be a rumor, but it came from someone who usually knows. I’ll try to find out the title before we meet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plan to everyone and make sure Noah gets the details too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might miss a detail or two, so I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep everyone in the loop and pass the book club details along to Noah too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it starts at 7 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there at 7.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet, but I’m curious—what are you reading for book club?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m reading a mystery novel this month—nothing too heavy, just a good page-turner. What kind of books do you usually like?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I usually like quiet, character-driven books, especially ones with a little mystery or humor.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules—I'm just checking our book club timing around the school pickup schedule. What day were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Faye! I was thinking Thursday evening, but I’m happy to adjust if pickup makes that tricky.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday evening could work for me if we keep it a bit later, after pickup. What time were you picturing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—just let me know the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll grab the details and let you know soon. Thanks for being flexible!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, I’ll wait to hear from you. Once you’ve got it, I’ll mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, the book club meets this Thursday evening at my place—you're very welcome to come! If you’re in, I can save you a spot and send over the book list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — I’d like to come, but could you send the book list first? I need to make sure I can get everything sorted in time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send the book list right over and save you a spot. Looking forward to having you there if it all works out!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still catching up on the book club news — what are folks reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re reading a mystery novel this month, and it’s been a big hit so far. I can send you the title and meeting details if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — I’d love the title and meeting details so I can catch up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the book title and the meeting time? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d love to, but I don’t have the title or meeting time in front of me right now. If you send me the details, I’ll make sure you’ve got them right.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem — send them over when you have them, and I’ll check the details before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can make it, though I may keep to the back and listen more than speak.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries at all — glad you can come, and you’re welcome to just listen. I’ll save you a seat in the back.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate that a lot — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—book club sounds nice. If you need a table or any extra chairs, I’ve got some you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Could I borrow the extra chairs for book club?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — I can lend you the extra chairs. Just let me know when you want to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the book club meets at the community center on Maple, usually on Thursday evenings. If you want, I can double-check the room number too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that sounds right—Thursday evenings at the community center on Maple. No need to double-check the room yet, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure thing — I’ll keep Thursday evenings at the community center on Maple in mind.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the book club needs a tool, I’m happy to lend one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind of you. I’ll keep that in mind if we need anything for book club.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime — just let me know if the club needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d love to join, but I need to make sure I can actually get there on time. What day and where are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: We’re still nailing it down, but probably Thursday at my place. Can you confirm if that works for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday might work, but I need the exact time first so I can check my ride and not be late.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’d be happy to help connect folks for book club—what’s the next meeting like?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you, Jules—next meeting is pretty relaxed: we chat about the book, share a few thoughts, and have tea and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds lovely—count me in. I’ll bring a little something for the snacks and help make the next meetup feel welcoming.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for book club. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — could you bring the extra bookmarks and a couple of pens? I’m probably going to join a little late again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll bring the extra bookmarks and a couple of pens, and I’ll set them aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a new read soon—have you heard what’s on the list?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, but I’m hoping they choose something short this time—my evenings are packed with school pick-up and homework.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Same here — I could use a short one too. If I hear what they pick, I’ll pass it along!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I’m in for book club—just send me the title and when we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Bo — I’ll send you the title and meeting time shortly!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll look out for it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — happy to help with the book club. What are we planning next?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s pick the next book and set a date for the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can suggest a couple of books and we can pick a meeting date that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I’d love to bring Nell along—when’s the next meet-up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet — I heard it might be next week, but I should double-check with someone and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries — just let me know when you hear, and I’ll be there!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where’s the book club meeting this time?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s at the library again this Thursday at 6. I’ll bring the sign-in sheet and a few extra chairs like we planned.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, the library at 6 on Thursday works for me. I’ll bring the books and help set up the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you picked the next book for the club yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I’m still comparing a few options so I can make sure we pick something everyone will enjoy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—want me to help narrow them down? If you’ve got the shortlist, I can give you my pick.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — I heard the book club is meeting again soon. Have you picked the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Not yet, I keep forgetting the list, but I’m hoping we can decide soon. I’ll check with the group and see what everyone wants to read.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — let me know when you all decide, and I’ll see if I can join.
